def transform(grid):
    panels=[grid[r][0:4] for r in range(4)], [grid[r][5:9] for r in range(4)], [grid[r][10:14] for r in range(4)], [grid[r][15:19] for r in range(4)]
    out=[]
    for r in range(4):
        row=[]
        for c in range(4):
            vals=[panels[i][r][c] for i in range(4)]
            active=set(v for v in vals if v)
            row.append(next((v for v in (9,4,8,5) if v in active),0))
        out.append(row)
    return out
print(transform(grid))
